evidence: Judge agent + model shared and pinned: task/task.toml [verifier.env] is exactly the frozen block (REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api", ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}", ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""), byte-identical to staged-task-contract.md. All five judge.toml files (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual) carry only the expected fallback `judge = "claude-code"` at line 2; grep for model|temperature|reasoning finds nothing else, so every dimension uses the one shared model. test.sh:63-64 refuses to grade when REWARDKIT_JUDGE/REWARDKIT_MODEL are unset (no silent default). Judge CLIs pinned: task/tests/Dockerfile:16-19 installs @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 at exact versions; line 31 harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7; line 41 patches rewardkit/agents.py with an assert that the exact old text exists (fails the build rather than drifting). Browser pinned: Dockerfile:33-38 installs chromium through the playwright cli nested inside the exact-pinned @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 and symlinks /usr/local/bin/chromium; every judge.toml launches playwright-mcp with --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium --headless --isolated. Shared tools: `diff` of the frozen template's tests/Dockerfile, tests/test.sh, tests/tools/score.py and tests/tools/restart_mcp.py against the task shows all four byte-identical (task tests/Dockerfile sha256 72998ab8...fd, test.sh bd682592...abe5aa). Fixed clock: no graded rule depends on the run date. instruction.md and hireops_rules.md contain no due dates, ages, expiries, 'today' or business-hours rules; time appears only as a 15-second propagation window (a duration measured by the judge, not a calendar value) and event ordering (newest-first activity, unread 'arrived after last open', undo 'since'). Seed timestamps span 2026-07-01T10:07:00Z..2026-07-29T11:15:00Z (130 message/note rows), all strictly before any current run date, and criteria never quote a date/time figure (grep of all judge.toml/prompt.md for today|date|timestamp|clock|ago|expire|deadline|overdue|week|2025|2026 hits only 'candidate'/'update' substrings). Session end in the draft rule is induced by sign-out in a shared-session tab (polish prompt.md:14 'never delete cookies or storage by script'), not by a timeout. So the fixed-clock part has nothing to pin and cannot make grading run-date dependent. Network posture public in both phases, which the row says is not a defect. Adversarial check: a broken app cannot exploit pinning (judge/model/browser are not submission-controlled); a conforming app that orders messages by its own wall-clock created_at still sorts new messages after the July 2026 seed under any realistic container clock, so it is not penalised. Residuals (not defects for this row, P3 at most): base images node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim and apt packages are tag-pinned, not digest-pinned, but this is the template-controlled Dockerfile (byte-identical; covered by row 10 and must be preserved); the exact chromium/playwright build is pinned transitively by @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 and was not read from a built image in this review. No full configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope says so); that absence does not bear on the static pinning this row checks, and no Oracle/model/portal result is claimed.
